description: This is a Java test class named ObjectTypeTests that contains unit tests for converting various object types to and from strings and other data types, using the ObjectType utility class. The tests cover date/time conversions, numeric conversions, collection conversions, and error handling scenarios.

classes.name: ObjectTypeTests
classes.description: Main test class for verifying object conversion utility functionality. Contains nested class LocaleData for locale and timezone info.

classes.name: ObjectTypeTests.LocaleData
classes.description: Inner class to encapsulate locale and timezone data used within tests.

methods.name: simpleTypeOrObjectConvert
methods.description: Wrapper for ObjectType.simpleTypeOrObjectConvert; performs object conversion with specified type, format, timezone, locale, and error handling flags.

methods.name: simpleTypeOrObjectConvertTest
methods.description: Performs a series of assertions to verify object conversion produces the expected results.

methods.name: simpleTypeOrObjectConvertError
methods.description: Verifies that attempting to convert with invalid data throws a GeneralException.

methods.name: basicTest
methods.description: Tests basic conversions such as toString, class name, and Object conversions.
